_comment: Apollo CSM/LM/S-IVB mass, propulsion and inertia data. Values are rounded public figures for the Apollo 11 vehicle [published] or engineering estimates [estimated]; see README.md (Fidelity). Masses in kg, forces in N, lengths in m, inertia in kg*m^2.

mass._lm_source: LM-5 Eagle, 15,103 kg with full tanks [published]: the descent stage's dry mass and the propellant loads (dps, aps, lm_rcs) [published, rounded]; the ascent stage's dry mass, with the crew and their equipment, makes up the total [estimated]

sps._source: AJ10-137: 20,500 lbf vacuum thrust, Isp 314 s [published]

sm_rcs._source: R-4D, 100 lbf, Isp ~290 s; four quads [published]; usable load per quad [estimated]

cm_rcs._source: SE-8, 93 lbf, two independent rings [published]; load [estimated]

sivb._source: J-2 vacuum thrust ~1,000 kN, Isp ~421 s [published]; propellant remaining at TLI [estimated]

dps._source: Descent engine: 10,125 lbf full thrust, throttleable from 10 % to 60 % [published]; Isp and propellant load [published, rounded]; transients [estimated]. P40 starts it at 10 % for 15 s and then burns at 40 %, as Apollo 11's DOI did [published]

aps._source: Ascent engine: 3,500 lbf, fixed thrust [published]; Isp and propellant load [published, rounded]; transients [estimated]

lm_rcs._source: R-4D, 100 lbf, Isp ~290 s; sixteen jets in four quads on the ascent stage, fed by two systems, A and B, 633 lb of propellant in all [published]; the jets each system fires per axis and their lever arms [estimated]

descent_guidance._source: The LGC's powered-descent targets, in a frame at the landing site: x up, y crossrange, z downrange (m, m/s, m/s², m/s³). Designed for this simulator [estimated] after Klumpp's Apollo lunar descent guidance (MIT Draper Laboratory, 1971): a quadratic acceleration to each target, the time to go set by its downrange jerk. The approach phase's reference starts at high gate, 2,100 m up and 7 km out at 35 m/s down and 100 m/s downrange, and hands over to P65 10 s before its target at 40 m. Powered descent starts 470 km (ground range) before the site, with 26 s at 10 % throttle, and lasts about 730 s

lm_gear._source: The LM on its landing gear: its centre of mass above the footpads, and the contact probes 5.6 ft below them [published]; the landing's speed limits for the gear [estimated]

docking._source: Probe-and-drogue docking [estimated throughout]: each docking port's distance from its vehicle's centre of mass along +X (the LM's, whole and as its ascent stage), the probe's push apart at undocking, the capture limits (closing speed, lateral speed, lateral miss, misalignment, relative rate), the radius within which the probe strikes the LM, and the rebound of a contact without capture

cm_aero._source: Hypersonic trim CD ~1.29, L/D ~0.30 on 3.91 m diameter [published, rounded]

els._source: Two 16.5 ft drogues at 24,000 ft, three 83.5 ft mains at 10,000 ft [published]; CdS [estimated]
